cases.description: Verify DELETE answers 403 MSG241 for a Member.
procedure: Sign in as a Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send DELETE /api/meetings/<meetingId>/agenda/<agendaItemId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId> with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 403 with { "code": "MSG241", "message": "Bạn không còn quyền gỡ liên kết tài liệu trong cuộc họp này." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify DELETE answers 409 MSG247 once the meeting has ended and 409 MSG349 when it is Cancelled.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send DELETE /api/meetings/<meetingId>/agenda/<agendaItemId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId> with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> on an Ended, then on a Cancelled meeting.
expected: Ended: HTTP 409 with { "code": "MSG247", ... }.
Cancelled: HTTP 409 with { "code": "MSG349", ... } (BR-299).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET .../comments lists the threads of a document, root comments first with one level of replies.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/comments with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body: { "meetingDocumentId", "canComment": true, "comments": [ { "id", "body", "pageNumber", "author": { "userId", "guestInvitationId", "name", "isGuest" }, "createdAt", "replies": [ ... ] } ] }.
Root comments are oldest first; replies sit inside the root comment, oldest first, one level only (BR-317).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. InProgress meeting; a document with a comment and a reply.

cases.description: Verify canComment is false once the meeting has ended or been cancelled.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/comments with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> on an Ended meeting, then on a Cancelled meeting.
expected: Both: HTTP 200 with "canComment": false (BR-282) and the existing comments still listed.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify a Member comments on a PDF page and the page is kept.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 201 Created.
Body: { "code": "MSG199", "message": "Đã gửi góp ý.", "comment": { "id", "body", "pageNumber": 3, "author", "createdAt", "replies": [] } }.
The author and time are recorded (BR-250) and the document's commentCount grows by one.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. InProgress meeting with a PDF of at least 3 pages.

cases.description: Verify a reply is stored under its root comment without a page of its own.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/comments with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and body { "body": "Đã sửa", "parentCommentId": "<commentId>", "pageNumber": 2 }.
expected: HTTP 201 MSG199; comment.pageNumber is null and GET shows it in replies of the root comment (UC-35 AF-2).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. A document with one comment.

cases.description: Verify a blank comment is rejected.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/comments with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and body { "body": "   " }.
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Body: { "code": "MSG200", "message": "Hãy nhập nội dung góp ý." } (BR-246); nothing is saved.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify the Organizer and the Approver can comment like anyone who can view the meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/comments with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and a valid body.
Sign in as the Approver (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token. Repeat.
expected: Both: HTTP 201 MSG199 (BR-249, BR-275).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. An Approver of the meeting.

cases.description: Verify POST answers 409 MSG349 for a Cancelled meeting.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/comments with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and a valid body.
expected: HTTP 409 with { "code": "MSG349", "message": "Cuộc họp đã huỷ nên không thay đổi được nữa." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. A Cancelled meeting.

cases.description: Verify a voter confirms reading a vote document and then can cast a ballot.
procedure: Sign in as a Member who is a voter of the Open vote (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/votes/<voteId>/ballots before and after the confirmation.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body: { "code": "MSG253", "message": "Đã xác nhận đọc tài liệu.", "meetingId", "meetingDocumentId", "confirmedAt", "alreadyConfirmed": false }; Cache-Control "no-store".
A ballot before every document is confirmed answers 409 MSG252 with the unread documents; after it, the ballot is accepted.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. InProgress meeting; an Open vote linking one document; the Member is on the voter list.

cases.description: Verify a second confirmation answers 200 alreadyConfirmed true and keeps the first time.
procedure: Sign in as a Member who is a voter (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.

Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/read-confirmation with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and { "lastPageReached": true } twice; send it a third time with { "lastPageReached": false }.
expected: All three: HTTP 200 MSG253; the later ones have alreadyConfirmed true and the same confirmedAt as the first (UC-74 AF-1, BR-291).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. A voter who has confirmed the document.

cases.description: Verify POST answers 409 MSG224 for a caller who is not on the voter list.
procedure: Sign in as a Member who is not on the voter list of the Open vote (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/<meetingId>/documents/<meetingDocumentId>/read-confirmation with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and { "lastPageReached": true }.
Sign in as the Secretary (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token. Repeat for a document attached only to a Draft vote.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict.

Body: { "code": "MSG224", "message": "Bạn không có trong danh sách được bỏ phiếu của biểu quyết này." } - the code of UC-55 for the same situation; a Draft vote has no fixed voter list yet, so a manager also gets it.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting with a Chair, a Secretary, a Member and an Organizer, in the needed status, supplied by QA lead. An Open vote whose fixed voter list excludes this Member.
